name: fork-sync
summary: Keeps the curated Blockchains forks in line with their upstreams: forks.json lists each fork, upstream, branch and mode (merge via the merge-upstream API, or tracking for forks whose GitHub parent differs from the real upstream); nightly workflow + box-side script.

entrypoints.name: forks.json
entrypoints.usage: slug, fork, upstream, upstream_branch, branch, mode, tracking_branch, category, license, wave

inputs.name: FORK_SYNC_TOKEN
inputs.description: enables real syncs in Actions; otherwise read-only drift check

compatible_with.how: indexes the synced forks nightly, after this runs
syncs its own fork list best-effort

env.name: FORK_SYNC_TOKEN
env.purpose: repo secret; PAT with repo + workflow on Blockchains
